## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
What problem does this solve? What workflow or scenario currently feels difficult or missing?
*(e.g., "When running an overnight agent session, I want to...")*

## Proposed Solution / Design
How should this work from a user perspective?
- What changes in the mobile UI?
- What changes in the desktop extension settings or notifications?

## Alignment with Architectural Guarantees
Antigravity Remote maintains strict architectural rules to guarantee security, performance, and portability:
- [ ] **Zero Runtime Dependencies**: Can this be implemented using native Web / Node.js APIs without adding packages to `dependencies`?
- [ ] **Lightweight VSIX (< 150 KB)**: Does this fit within our bundle size budget?
- [ ] **Privacy & E2EE**: Does this preserve zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption and avoid sending sensitive workspace data to untrusted servers?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or diagrams to illustrate the proposed feature.
